title: General Roya makes him a warrant officer, then chief warrant officer

tellings.quote: he said uh uh I'm going to make you a warrant officer

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that in the late 1970s at US Army headquarters a general he calls General Roya told him he would make him a warrant officer, a specialist rank that sits between enlisted soldiers and commissioned officers. According to McMoneagle, he was later raised to chief warrant officer. He tells it to show how much the Army valued the work he was doing.
